blocks.html: May is the month of the Blessed Virgin Mary and one of the Marian devotions widely celebrated during this month is the Flores de Mayo or Santacruzan. In celebration of the Santacruzan, Robinsons Novaliches hosts The Marian Exhibition at the Trade Hall from 10 am to 9 pm until May 31. The exhibit showcases designer gowns depicting Marian titles such as Reyna Elena, Rosa Mystica, and Reyna Emperatriz. The gowns presented in the Marian Exhibit is elegantly worn by models from House of Mode Elle and crafted by talented fashion designers namely Edwin Uy, Cheena Ng Lio, Alma Quizado, Rennie Braza, Russ Cuevas and Makoolay Collections. Blessed Mary images - Our Lady of the Barangay, Our Lady of Manaoag, Our Lady of Fatima, Our Lady of Lourdes, Our Lady of Mt. Carmel and the blessed image of San Isidro Labrador will also be displayed.
